neighbours.label: the subject (' She', ' He', surname) in a present-tense biography of a living person, before 'has' or 'is'; dead people and institutions stay quiet

Mark Ferris, 47, directs the choir at Oberlin. He has recorded four albums and regularly tours in Asia.

quiet: Anna Lindqvist was a senior lecturer in chemistry at Uppsala until she died in 1871. For ten years, Lindqvist led a team of twelve. She won three grants.
